note: Cameras for the Call Sheet Camera node. device replaces the frame's lens and focus words (keepLens keeps them), light goes in before the frame's own light, finish replaces its grain and film words. Flaws and skin bits marked on start on. Looks replace the frame's palette and color words with grade, and its light words with light when a look has one; frame goes at the end of the camera line.
